name: LPKF Laser & Electronics SE
blurb: LPKF Laser & Electronics SE is a German technology company that develops and manufactures laser-based solutions for the electronics, semiconductor, and medical technology industries. Its key growth areas include Advanced Semiconductor Packaging and LIDE (Laser Induced Deep Etching) for glass processing. The company holds a strong market position in laser systems for PCB prototyping and micro-material processing.
recent: In the past 30 days, LPKF reported weaker Q1 2026 results with lower sales and a larger loss, but the stock surged as investors focused on its Advanced Semiconductor Packaging and LIDE growth potential. The share price reached a 52-week high of €29.90 on May 11, 2026, reflecting a year-to-date return of over 350%. The stock has since pulled back slightly, trading around €25.70 as of mid-May.
